text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since<n>Wonder Acute
began cutting weight,<n>and her running has already
grown<n>more refined as a result.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's been laser-focused during<n>training, eager to
pick up new skills<n>she'll need for the big race. One
could<n>easily mistake her for a post-debut<n>runner.
However...
choice_data_list: Don't swing too wide on those turns!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I hear you. You can count on me!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Mm, I'm feeling great.Whatever drills you put me through,my body can keep up just fine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now to hammer all these lessons<n>home, I think I'll
go for another run<n>before the morning's over. The
big<n>day's almost here, so there's no<n>time to waste!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing no such thing. Now that I'm<n>light as a
feather—see?—nothing can<n>bring me down.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I return a nod, seeing how energetic<n>she looks, but
deep down I'm<n>worried.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's been doing well on her new<n>training
regimen... too well, almost.<n>Her single-minded
dedication has led<n>to greater weight loss than I
planned<n>for.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, I spot Wonder Acute<n>eating the bare
minimum amount of<n>food allowed by her regimen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she drops lower than her optimal<n>race weight, this
whole thing will<n>backfire. I'm about to tell her to eat
her normal amount, when...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Acute. Mind if I have a<n>word with you
real quick? ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well I never! Falco wants to have aword with me? Is something thematter, darling?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's just—and sorry if this is<n>overstepping—but
are you maybe on a<n>diet right now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your lunch is just so small I couldn't<n>help but
notice. And you haven't<n>been eating much for
dinner at the<n>dorm lately either.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong—as an Umadol, I<n>like to be
mindful of how I look too.<n>But you know, I don't
think it's good<n>to go too far with a diet either.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see now, you were just worried for<n>me, weren't
you? I'm all right, just<n>getting into shape for a race
is all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, by a race, you mean the Tracen<n>Meet? Oh
that's right, you're running<n>in the dirt 2,000-meter
too, aren't<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... but Acute, you haven't had<n>your debut yet,
right? I'd still be<n>worried about pushing yourself too
hard before you're race-ready.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you see, if I want to get first, it's<n>the only way,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, there's a certain<n>someone I want to
win for, so I'm<n>going to do everything I can to do
just that.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: To win... Right, of course.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Silly Falco! I know how much winning<n>means to me,
but it completely slipped<n>my mind that you'd feel
the same<n>way!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Forget what I said! ☆ We're rivals<n>now! And I
won't settle for anything<n>less than center stage
either. Let's<n>both give it all we've got, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let's. I'll make sure to get my<n>body into
shape so I can run my very<n>best race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Growwwl...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Look at you, already growling<n>up a storm so
soon after eating. Hang<n>in there just a little longer,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Once the race is over, you can have<n>all the crunchy
munchies you want.<n>Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to keep an eye on her from<n>a distance, but
I guess I'm not as<n>sneaky as I thought. An
awkward<n>smile greets me as I show my face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You really are the biggest worrywart<n>around. You
were listening to my little<n>chat with Falco too,
weren't you?
choice_data_list: ...So you won't go back to your usual portion sizes?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The big day's just around the<n>corner—nothing
needs changing now.<n>I'm only doing what I need to
in order<n>to win.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I still don't get why she's pushing<n>herself so hard.
Does the Tracen<n>Meet really mean that much to
her?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You see, I have a point to prove. I'm<n>going to show
a certain someone that<n>they're not "unfit to be a
trainer" after<n>all.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I... I'm unfit to be a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I... I'm unfit to be a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That day, when I saw you looking all<n>tore up, I
couldn't just leave you be.<n>But ever since you
started helping me<n>train, I've been thinking...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just how many people like you are<n>there? A trainer
willing to stay up all<n>night working on a training plan
for<n>someone who isn't even their<n>trainee.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
One willing to make tweaks to that<n>plan over and
over again as we grow.<n>One who's ready to devote
so much<n>of their time, all of the time, for our<n>sakes...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now you tell me, how could someone<n>like that be
unfit to be a trainer? Just<n>look how much I've
grown since<n>working with you—that's all the
evidence you need.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to prove it once and for<n>all. If I do well
in this race, you'll have<n>no choice but to recognize
how<n>wonderful a trainer you are.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A win in this race would mean an<n>awful lot to
someone I know. So no<n>matter what, I need to earn
this win<n>for that someone.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It never even occurred to me that Imight be that someone. But thinkingback to how we met, maybe it shouldcome as no surprise.
choice_data_list: But I barely know you. Why go so far for me?
But I barely know you. Why go so far for me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose it's because you<n>remind me of
someone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You see, my daddy was a star boxer<n>back in his
day, won Rookie of the<n>Year and everything. But
after that, he<n>couldn't quite find the same success.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
He retired without any more big wins<n>under his belt,
and ended up in a dark<n>place for a spell. But with
my<n>momma's support, he managed to<n>get back on
his feet.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, Daddy did his fair<n>share of
shameful things. But your<n>momma was there for
me. That's<n>how I got back up.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
So now, it's my turn to be there for<n>someone else.
When life's trying to<n>knock you down, having a
pillar to<n>lean on can keep you on your feet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And now he's a role model—his<n>boxing gym is full
of people looking to<n>regain their footing in life just
like<n>him.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Growing up watching them, I learned<n>to always hold
out a helping hand<n>where I can. If there's a heart
close<n>to breaking, I want to be the brace<n>holding it
together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I can save someone with my<n>running, then I'll run
with all I have.<n>That's reason enough to try my
best,<n>wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Am I now? Flattery won't get you<n>anything but
pickles, I'm afraid. And<n>besides...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling that says I can get<n>stronger and
stronger yet. It tells me I<n>can push myself harder,
sharpen my<n>skills even further.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who planted this<n>feeling in me, you
know? And it all<n>started because I put my trust in
you<n>and worked to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, I want you to trust me too.<n>Mark my
words, I'll prove to you<n>just how amazing of a
person you<n>are!
